messages:
maya: Quick design review thread — private setup wizard network step. Sharing a small figma preview: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (ignore colors). Main decisions: advanced mode toggle, how we label severity, and whether to surface actionable commands for admins.
aj: Nice. High-level: make the scan less scary for non-network folks. Suggest renaming header to 'Helpful checks' instead of 'Prerequisites' so it reads friendlier.
samir: +1. Also we should show a compact timeline of probes with simple pass / warn / fail states and a 'why' CTA that expands details — SSH / HTTPS / DNS rows.
elaine: Accessibility note: probe status updates should use aria-live="polite" and each probe needs descriptive text (not just an icon). Keyboard focus must remain in the details panel when someone expands a row.
maya: Sketch idea: collapsed "Advanced network details" by default. Each failed probe gets a 'Show me help' link that opens steps. For severity badges propose: Info / Caution / Failure (text + color) instead of relying on color alone.
aj: Copy tweaks: change 'Retry probes' -> 'Re-run checks' and 'Open firewall?' -> 'Open required ports' (more prescriptive). Also 'Dismiss' should be 'Dismiss suggestion' for clarity.
samir: Example probe log we might surface in advanced view (sanitized): ```ERR: outbound_connect 10.0.0.1:443 timeout after 5s
PROBE: curl https://metadata.redwood.local -> HTTP 200
DNS: lookup private-domain -> NXDOMAIN```
elaine: :eyes: For screen readers, make the failure CTA include the short reason text, e.g. 'TLS handshake failed: untrusted cert' so SR users get actionable context rather than just 'fail'.
ux-bot: Design note: consider a Beginner vs Advanced mode toggle. Beginner hides raw logs and shows 1-click remediation suggestions like 'Add SSH egress rule' which open a small guided helper. Advanced shows logs, commands, and copyable snippets.
maya: Question for eng: can probe results include suggested iptables/ufw commands in the advanced view? @samir
samir: @maya we can surface commands, but they must be copy-only and behind a confirmation (marked as potentially dangerous). We shouldn't auto-run anything.
aj: Layout nit: keep status badge on the left, probe name in the middle, CTA on the right. Improves scanning. Also tighten vertical spacing so teams with many probes don't have to scroll a ton.
maya: I'll update the figma and push a small variant for the lab. Running a quick usability lab with 6 customers next Wed to validate phrasing and the Begin/Advanced flow. Any objections?
elaine: No objections. I'll draft the ARIA snippet and share by Friday.
aj: :thumbsup:
